# @orbclub/modules

Purpose: auth-first modules for Sign in with Orb (browser-site protocol, run in the page), the site opt-in manifest, Lens session helpers, media parsing, Grove uploads, and optional backend transport.

Read in this order:
- `README.md`
- `docs/getting-started.md`
- `docs/auth.md`
- `docs/configuration.md`
- `docs/media.md`
- `docs/upload-grove.md`
- `docs/transport-backend.md`
- `docs/errors.md`
- `docs/release.md`
- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `AGENTS.md`

Capability map:
- root: `createSDK`, core errors, core types
- `@orbclub/modules/auth`: `createOrbLogin`, `authPlugin`, `watchSessionExpiry`, token/session helpers, auth errors
- `@orbclub/modules/auth/site`: `createSiwoManifestHandler`, `createSiwoManifest`, `ORB_SIWO_MANIFEST_PATH`, `SiwoManifestConfigError`
- `@orbclub/modules/auth/qr`: `qrAuthPlugin`, `connectWithQr`, `prefersDeepLink`, QR errors (legacy request/parse helpers are throwing stubs)
- `@orbclub/modules/auth/lens`: `lensAuthPlugin`, Lens GraphQL refresh/revoke helpers
- `@orbclub/modules/media`: `mediaPlugin`, media MIME helpers
- `@orbclub/modules/upload/grove`: `groveUploadPlugin`, Grove upload errors
- `@orbclub/modules/transport/backend`: `backendTransportPlugin`, backend transport errors

Runtime map:
- `auth`: browser or server
- `auth/qr`: browser only (never proxy it through a server)
- `auth/site`: server (any Fetch-API runtime: Next.js route handlers, Hono, workers)
- `auth/lens`: browser or server Lens GraphQL refresh flow
- `media`: browser or server
- `upload/grove`: browser-only
- `transport/backend`: trusted runtime or app proxy

Sign in with Orb behavior (browser-site protocol):
- `createOrbLogin().connectWithQr({ signal, onInit, onProvisioning })` is the happy path; run it in the browser
- init: `POST https://orbapi.xyz/init-site-sign-in {state, codeChallenge}` (PKCE S256, 43-char base64url values); the page Origin identifies the site
- fetch options: `mode: cors`, `credentials: omit`, `cache: no-store`, `redirect: error`, `referrerPolicy: no-referrer`, 10s timeout
- `phase: PROVISIONING` = first use of an origin; retried every 10s, max 6 attempts, then `QrProvisioningError`; setup can take a few minutes
- `phase: READY` gives `session`, `qrCode`, `deepLink` (`orbapp://orb/approve?secret=<64 hex>`), `expiresAt`; every field is validated before `onInit`
- `onInit` receives only `{ qrCode, deepLink, expiresAt }`; show `deepLink` as "Open Orb app" when `prefersDeepLink()` (pointer: coarse)
- poll: `POST https://orbapi.xyz/poll-site-sign-in {session, state, codeVerifier}` every 2.5s until `expiresAt` (~5 min); network/5xx/429 retried; `FAILED` stops
- success: `{ processed: true, source: "lens", user_id, idToken, accessToken, expiresAt }`; any `refreshToken` in the response is rejected
- no refresh token exists; access token lives ~10 min; end the session at `expiresAt` (`watchSessionExpiry`) and re-prompt
- `createOrbLogin().refresh()` always rejects with `AUTH_REFRESH_UNSUPPORTED`
- failures carry `reason`: `expired`, `cancelled`, `unavailable`, `provisioning`, `invalid`, `configuration`
- rate limits are per client IP (12 inits/min, 120 polls/min; 30 polls/min per session): never proxy sign-in through a server
- legacy `/init-sign-in`, `/poll-sign-in`, `/exchange-sign-in-code`, `/.well-known/orb-sign-in.json` are disabled; legacy options/helpers throw `QrLegacyFlowError`

Site requirements:
- serve `GET /.well-known/orb-siwo.json` -> 200 `application/json`, body exactly `{"version":1,"origin":"https://<exact origin>"}` (< 2KB, no trailing slash)
- `createSiwoManifestHandler({ origin })` or `({ origins })` from `@orbclub/modules/auth/site` returns a `(request?: Request) => Response` handler
- Next.js: `export const GET = createSiwoManifestHandler({ origin })` in `app/.well-known/orb-siwo.json/route.ts`
- Hono: `app.get(ORB_SIWO_MANIFEST_PATH, (c) => handler(c.req.raw))`, registered before any SPA fallback
- CSP: add `https://orbapi.xyz` to `connect-src`
- preview deployments on other origins cannot sign in; `http://localhost` cannot use this protocol

Lens auth behavior:
- default Lens GraphQL endpoint is `https://api.lens.xyz/graphql`
- `refreshLensSession(...)` requires a non-blank `refreshToken`
- `revokeLensSession(...)` requires a non-blank `authenticationId` and `accessToken`
- Lens refresh success requires `AuthenticationTokens` with a non-blank `accessToken`
- `syncLensSession(...)` without a `refreshToken` returns the session while its access token is valid, else `null`
- with a `refreshToken`, it returns `null` for Lens `ForbiddenError` responses and keeps the hydrated session on transient failures

Media normalization:
- resolves `ipfs://`, `ar://`, `lens://`, and embedded storage URIs through configured gateways
- strips existing `thumbnailDimension...` proxy prefixes before optional gateway wrapping
- preserves `data:`, `blob:`, `file:`, and bare paths without a recognized URI scheme
- returns `null` for `javascript:` and `vbscript:` URLs

Backend transport behavior:
- `baseUrl` must use `http` or `https`
- `transport.call(path, ...)` only accepts paths relative to `baseUrl`
- paths cannot escape the configured `baseUrl` path with dot segments
- header names and values are validated before a request is sent

Rules for agents:
- Prefer root + subpath imports; do not invent root re-exports for plugins.
- Do not reintroduce Orb-specific env names, hardcoded URLs, or backend route names.
- Keep the core framework-agnostic.
- Update `README.md`, `llms.txt`, and the relevant docs page whenever the public surface changes.
